description: Demo example for SynchroB presentation — feature-building prompt with curated response (hardcoded, no API call)
prompt: I want to add real-time notifications and alerting rules that users can configure themselves

notes.how_it_works: This exact prompt is matched in matching_engine.py and returns a curated response without calling the Claude API. Any other prompt still uses the live LLM.
demo_talking_points: Prompt describes a FEATURE to build, not a service to buy — SynchroB recommends code to learn from
Grafana (92%) — study their visual rule builder and notification routing
Sentry (85%) — study their smart event grouping and escalation policies
Prometheus (74%) — study their rule evaluation engine and alert suppression
Three products, three different lessons for building the same feature
Each recommendation includes specific capabilities with file paths as evidence
